thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] GPU pool 'pool-north-1' queued requests > 10k for 3 consecutive minutes. Severity: P1. Auto-scale attempts failing (limit reached).

maria: paging @hao_oncall — spike in inference traffic, queue growth on north-1. looks like autoscaler hit maxReplicas. can you take? :pager:

hao_oncall: on it. looking at autoscaler logs now. grabbing recent metrics from prometheus.

hao_oncall: quick snapshot: queue_length ~ 12.3k, avg_latency 980ms, tokens/s down 40%.
metric: redwood_gpu_pool_queue{pool="pool-north-1"} 12345

liz_sre: copying kubectl to scale options. But note we have a hard cap on that pool (max 40 nodes) due to quota. we already at 39.

ben_platform: FYI cloud quota for the region shows 40/40 gpus used. RESERVED capacity for some dedicated customers consumes ~6 nodes.

maria: customer-impact: a handful of high-traffic customers seeing throttling/errors. CS reported increased error rates for embedding jobs. jay_cs, assigning to you to triage customer comms.

jay_cs: pinged the top 5 affected customers with ETA 30m. will update them once we have mitigation.

hao_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) drain low-priority queues -> route to fallback model in other region 2) enable spot burst in eu-west as temporary 3) temporarily reduce max_batch_size on heavy models to reduce per-request lockup. starting with (1).

liz_sre: how do we route? we have routing policy for overflow but it only triggers when region latency < 200ms. need a manual override flag `force-overflow`.

hao_oncall: found the flag. setting force-overflow=true for pool-north-1 -> pool-eu-west. applying now:

```
# set routing override
curl -X POST https://control-plane/api/v1/routing/overflow -d '{"src":"pool-north-1","dst":"pool-eu-west","force":true}' -H "Authorization: Bearer ***"
```

maria: sending command to router. monitor traffic shift.

ben_platform: router accepted rule. starting traffic shift. watch for cross-region latency regressions.

hao_oncall: traffic is shifting. queue length down to 6.1k. latency on eu-west bumped +180ms but within SLO for non-urgent customers.

jay_cs: customers A and C acknowledged. Customer B still reporting errors, looks like they were pinned to dedicated pool.

liz_sre: for dedicated-backed customers we can't route. I recommend spinning a temporary spare node by preempting lower-priority dedicated reservations (with approval).

maria: approve preemptible bump if it reduces errors for paying customers. go ahead, liaise with finance if needed.

ben_platform: submitted spare allocation request to cloud provider and enabled spot bursting. spinning up 4 nodes. expected ready ~8m.

hao_oncall: enabling temporary throttling for public sandbox tenants to free capacity. applying throttle rule: `max_concurrency=2` for sandbox route.

```
# throttle enforcement
PATCH /control-plane/api/v1/tenants/sandbox/policies
{"max_concurrency":2}
```

hao_oncall: sandbox throughput down 70%, queue fell to 2.8k, overall queue across pool-north-1 now 1.5k.

jay_cs: customer B back to normal after preemptible node allocation. reporting success.

maria: good. immediate mitigations: overflow routing + spot nodes + sandbox throttling + preemptible for dedicated customers. document these in the incident timeline.

liz_sre: root cause hypothesis: sudden burst from a large partner batch + our autoscaler config's maxReplicas too conservative for this workload shape. autoscaler repeatedly attempted scale but cloud quota blocked it -> backoff and queue growth.

hao_oncall: logs show repeated scale attempts and then "quota exceeded" errors in cloud provider api. snippet:
```
ERROR cloudprovider: quotaExceeded: cannot create instance, region quota 40 reached
stack: autoscaler/scale.go:142
```

ben_platform: action item: request quota increase for north-1 to 60 GPUs. filing ticket with cloud provider now and internal runbook to track.

maria: also action: review autoscaler policy: consider raising maxReplicas for bursty workloads and add soft-fallback to route overflow earlier. add canary rules to avoid sudden region hits.

liz_sre: I'll add postmortem items: - autoscaler maxReplicas review - routing force-overflow behavior and guardrails - add alert for "quota close to limit" (threshold at 85%) - document preemptible escalation flow - update runbooks

hao_oncall: handoff to liz_sre for post-incident cleanup. I'm staying on until metrics stable. Current queue north-1 = 420, tokens/s ~ normal.

liz_sre: thanks. will take over. will produce postmortem draft and assign owners for action items.

jay_cs: will post a customer summary once postmortem action items and ETA for quota resolution are available.

maria: follow-ups: 1) liz -> postmortem + assign 2) ben -> quota request + cloud ticket id 3) hao -> write quick autobump playbook for oncall to follow when pool nearing quota 4) jay -> customer comms draft.

liz_sre: noted. creating issue INF-872 (postmortem) and adding initial timeline. will cc SRE, Platform, CS.

incident-bot: [UPDATE] Incident status: mitigated -> partial (overflow/routing mitigations in place, customers recovered). Pager remains active until postmortem complete.

maria: thanks team. closing active paging once postmortem ticket created and owners assigned. great quick coordination. :clap:
